title: Discover OpenSCAD capabilities
description: Discover live availability, constraints and tool names for Runtime, Libraries, Customizer and diagnostics. No changes; returns bounded capability metadata.
gui: AI Panel capability tables / Refresh availability

title: Inspect OpenSCAD operations
description: Poll a specific operation ID or list recent operations. Returns running/terminal state and progress message, no changes.

title: Cancel OpenSCAD operation
description: Cancel one Agent operation by exact id, OR request cancellation of the current Runtime installation / Library task by domain=runtime|libraries, including tasks started in the GUI. Choose exactly one. Returns cancellationRequested, not proof the task stopped: re-read domain state or operation status; critical transactions may finish.

title: Read OpenSCAD Runtime: current CLI and installed versions
description: Read the SAME local runtime inventory as Runtime Panel, without opening it. state.activeRuntime is the currently selected CLI with full version, command.executable, argsPrefix, source and release metadata, or null if none is selected; it is independent of pagination. state.runtimes.items lists detected installed CLI versions/paths/sources; follow hasMore/nextOffset to enumerate all. discovery reports ready/restricted/error and configured-path failures. This inventory is on the workspace extension host, not necessarily the client machine, and is not an exhaustive filesystem scan. Use runtime_refresh when stale; discovery/probing requires Workspace Trust. runtime_builds lists downloadable releases, NOT installed versions.

title: List OpenSCAD builds
description: Read all downloadable OpenSCAD CLI releases for the extension host, including exact build IDs, versions, channels and installed flags. Set refresh=true to force the SAME online refresh as the GUI Available Refresh button, even when cached. Follow builds.hasMore/nextOffset; optional channel filter. Catalog errors fail explicitly; installed versions/current CLI are available from runtime_state. Network read only. recommendedBuild returns the full recommended release independently of filtering/pagination, matching the GUI recommendation card.

title: Discover OpenSCAD runtimes
description: Rescan locally installed CLI runtimes (default mode=rescan), or coalesce a silent Installed-tab refresh with mode=installed. Requires Workspace Trust because discovery probes executables. Does not refresh the ONLINE catalog: use runtime_builds with refresh=true for the GUI Available Refresh action. Returns selected CLI, installed inventory and discovery status.

title: Install exact OpenSCAD build
description: Install an exact numeric build ID returned by runtime_builds. Downloads to managed storage; supports cancellation and returns verified discovery state. Requires trust.

title: Install OpenSCAD archive
description: Install a host-local archive at an absolute path. Validates archive safety and probes runtime; managed storage only, trust required. Supports cancellation.

title: Add OpenSCAD executable
description: Probe and select a host-local executable or macOS app at an absolute path. Changes global runtime selection after validation; trust required.

title: Select OpenSCAD runtime
description: Select the exact runtime ID from runtime_state. Changes global runtime configuration; returns actual active runtime and updates Preview. Trust and current identity required.

title: Remove managed OpenSCAD runtime
description: Remove an exact managed runtime ID from runtime_state. Independent user confirmation required; unmanaged paths rejected. Revalidates managed identity and returns discovered state.

title: Read model Customizer
description: Read active model target URI, revision, complete parameter types/ranges/default/current values and preset status. Overrides do not edit SCAD source; no panel required.

title: Set model parameters atomically
description: Set validated parameter overrides atomically on the exact target/revision from customizer_state. Values must match parameter schema. Updates GUI/Preview; does not edit SCAD source.

title: Reset model parameters
description: Reset one named parameter or all overrides for exact target/revision. Returns actual values; updates Preview without editing source.

title: applyPreset OpenSCAD presets
description: applyPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Empty name applies design defaults. Overrides do not edit source. Each selection starts from design defaults plus this set, clearing prior set Overrides. Unverified file versions are read-only.

title: createPreset OpenSCAD presets
description: createPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state.

title: savePreset OpenSCAD presets
description: savePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state.

title: deletePreset OpenSCAD presets
description: deletePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Requires independent user confirmation.

title: importPresets OpenSCAD presets
description: importPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Import does not apply a set. Unknown versions are preserved for read-only analysis; apply and writes require verified compatibility.

title: exportPresets OpenSCAD presets
description: exportPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Current-value snapshots must replay without value or type loss; otherwise PRESET_INVALID_VALUE preserves files and state. Exporting existing sets does not validate the current snapshot.

title: Search OpenSCAD libraries
description: Search real registry metadata for IDs, exact versions and supported layouts. Bounded query, pagination and optional detail ID. Returns freshness/errors; no install. Includes the same layout/installability errors, version labels and cached flags shown in GUI registry rows.

title: Refresh OpenSCAD registry
description: Refresh registry independent of panels. Network read, returns actual catalog status/errors; cached data is identified.

title: Read project dependencies
description: List workspace projects, or dependencies for one exact project path returned by this tool. Reports manifest/lock and mount state; no writes. Includes shared busy/cancellable/message/error activity for tasks started in GUI or Agent; use operation_cancel with domain=libraries to request cancellation, then read state until busy clears.

title: Read global library cache
description: Inspect bounded global cache metadata, integrity issues and references. Exact cache keys identify verify/repair/cleanup targets. No raw file inventories. Includes shared busy/cancellable/message/error activity for tasks started in GUI or Agent; use operation_cancel with domain=libraries to request cancellation, then read state until busy clears.

title: install OpenSCAD project dependency
description: Install exact version label returned by libraries_search; writes project manifest/lock and mounts using shared atomic transactions. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

title: remove OpenSCAD project dependency
description: Remove project dependency; preserves global cached sources. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

title: restore OpenSCAD project dependency
description: Restore dependencies using authoritative lockfile commits; never silently re-resolve tags. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

title: Verify global library cache
description: Verify one exact cache key or all cached versions. Checks local inventory corruption, not independent supply-chain authenticity. Returns actual failures, trust required.

title: Repair global library version
description: Repair an exact cache key from globalState. Rechecks repository/commit identity; requires trust, supports cancellation and preserves source safety checks.

title: Plan global library cleanup
description: Read-only preflight of single cache key or mode unused/all. Returns expiring server plan ID, candidates, bytes, protections and impact; does not delete. Requires trust.

title: Execute confirmed library cleanup
description: Execute an unexpired exact plan ID from cleanupPlan. Independently asks the human to authorize exact targets; JSON cannot approve deletion. Rechecks state/references under store locks. Returns actual removals.

title: Read GitHub connection status
description: Refresh silently and read GitHub mode/account label/rate-limit hint only. Never returns tokens or session objects.

title: Authorize GitHub access
description: Start real interactive VS Code GitHub authentication. User must complete Accounts flow. Returns safe status only; no access token is exposed. Anonymous access remains available.

title: Read development diagnostics availability
description: Read whether extension runs in Development mode. Safe in production; reports reason when cache tools are disabled.

title: List disposable cache metadata
description: Development mode only. Returns bounded cache IDs/names/scopes without values. Installed runtimes, exporter and library sources/reference indices are excluded. Returns the extension-owned storage directory and pagination metadata; no cache values.

title: Inspect redacted cache entry
description: Development mode only. Inspect one exact cache ID from listCaches. Returns bounded redacted preview, which may still contain personal information. No arbitrary file reads.

title: Clear confirmed disposable caches
description: Development mode only. Choose exactly one cache ID, scope or all=true. Independent user confirmation required; clears only disposable caches, reports partial failures and invalidates owners.

title: Analyze Customizer source
description: Analyze Customizer declarations in an explicit workspace .scad URI, including unsaved editor text. Returns source version/hash, actual widgets, ranges, candidates and bounded diagnostics; complete=false is not success. Unlike customizer_state this reads source, not Overrides. Analyze before sourceApply; correct invalid inputs or unsupported forms rather than guessing.

title: Plan or commit Customizer source edits
description: Author Customizer SOURCE, not runtime Overrides: plan bounded literal/annotation/group edits with sourceAnalyze version/hash, inspect preview, then commit the single-use planId within 120 seconds. Successful plans return data.continuation: review the diff and invoke its registered tool with its input unchanged (mode and planId only). requiresReview is guidance, never authorization or a Commit input field. Requires Workspace Trust and commit confirmation; never accepts model approval. Writes only the buffer, never saves. On STALE_SOURCE reanalyze and replan; on NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW stop unchanged-source retries, use ordinary editor changes only if the user task permits them, otherwise explain manual handling. Check applied AND semanticPass/postValidation; never claim success after failure.

mode.description: plan requires uri, identity.version, identity.sha256 and edits; commit requires only planId. Copy identity and planId from actual previous results.

identity.description: Nested object copied from sourceAnalyze data.identity: version is a number and sha256 is a string. Do not send version or sha256 as root fields.

edits.description: Array of intent DATA objects. Each has one exact kind and name, with the fields required by that kind. Do not send JSON Schema keywords or a shell command.

planId.description: Opaque ID from a successful sourceApply mode=plan data.planId. Never use sourceAnalyze operation.id.

title: Validate Customizer source
description: Read and validate current workspace .scad buffer against optional explicit widget/type/group/default/range/choice expectations. Unlike customizer_state, validates source declarations, not Overrides. Without expectations proves only static consistency. complete=false or semanticPass=false is failure. Runtime and GUI checks are separately notRequested; use existing Preview when requested. Correct diagnostics and validate again. Unmet explicit targets are returned in expectationResults, never as syntax errors or Problems diagnostics. With no expectations, missing Customizer grammar and normal SCAD usage are not diagnostic failures. Inspect sourceStatus, contractStatus, qualityStatus and per-target details; contractStatus=notRequested does not establish a target.
